newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Oct 26.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Oct 26.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 1.761 million tonnes in the week ended October 26, down from 1.799 million tonnes in the previous week, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.
CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week 21 of the 1996 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content fell to 14.11 percent from 14.19 percent the week before.
The latest week brought this year's crush to 32.35 million tonnes, up from 28.18 million tonnes at the same time in 1995.
Australian sugar cane crush by region for the week ended October 26 as reported by CANEGROWERS in tonnes.
The 1995 crush started on June 13 and ended by December 30.
CCS = Commercial Cane Sugar (sugar content percent)-

1995 Summary - Total cane crushed 37.389 million tonnes (Qld 35.295 million, NSW 2.094 million), sugar produced 4.98 million tonnes 94 n.t., (Qld 4.73 million, NSW 244,629), sugar content (CCS) 13.12 percent (Qld 13.22 percent, NSW 11.41 percent).
